مُحَوَّرٌ Dough of which the surface has been moistened with water, so that it is shining. (TA.) [See also 2.] ―
-b2- أَعْيُنٌ مُحَوَّرَاتٌ, in a verse of El- 'Ajjáj, Eyes of a clear white [in the white parts] and intensely black in the black parts. (S.) ＝
-A2- A boot lined with skin of the kind called حَوَرٌ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
